mechanism: Nalmefene (opioid antagonist) may reduce the efficacy of trazodone and increase CNS depression risk; trazodone's serotonergic activity combined with opioid antagonism creates unpredictable neurochemical effects.
action: Monitor for reduced antidepressant efficacy and increased sedation; use with caution and consider alternative agents if opioid antagonism is needed; educate patient on CNS depression risks.
